title: Arvind Mehta v. Sub-Registrar, Zone IV

brief.about: The appellant claims refund of excess stamp duty of Rs. 6,20,000 paid on a sale deed that was later cancelled by a decree. The refund application was rejected as time-barred.
brief.last: None is present for the respondent again though service is complete. In the interest of justice one more opportunity is given. If nobody appears on the next date the appeal will be heard ex parte.
watch: A party did not appear last time
